objectives: Listens to nursery rhymes or poems read by the teacher and responds with appropriate sounds, words, and motion. Follows verbal directions. Describes pictures in oral sentences.
Rhymes word patterns in poems. Matches same initial word sounds with written word symbols. Recognizes and names upper and lower case alphabet letters.
Models and draws lines demonstrating the concept of “top to bottom” and “left to right”. Models and forms lower and upper case letters of the alphabet. Copies simple words.
Uses simple vocabulary and short phrases in Spanish.
